criterion: which COVID-19-related user intent the utterance expresses

categories.name: COVID-19 General Information
categories.definition: User seeks broad facts, definitions, myths, or general news about COVID-19, its origin, or potential cures/vaccines.

categories.name: COVID-19 Symptoms and Treatment
categories.definition: User asks about identifying symptoms, diagnosis, or medical/home treatment options for COVID-19.

categories.name: COVID-19 Transmission and Prevention
categories.definition: User inquires about how COVID-19 spreads, how long it survives, or methods to protect oneself and others from infection.

categories.name: COVID-19 Statistics and Data
categories.definition: User requests numerical data such as case counts, death tolls, recovery rates, testing figures, or demographic impacts of COVID-19.

categories.name: COVID-19 Travel and Restrictions
categories.definition: User asks about travel advisories, restrictions, high-risk areas, or quarantine guidelines related to COVID-19.

categories.name: COVID-19 Local/Regional Updates
categories.definition: User seeks news or updates specific to a particular geographic location regarding COVID-19.

categories.name: Donation and Support
categories.definition: User expresses an intent to donate money or resources, or asks for information on how to provide support for COVID-19 relief efforts.

categories.name: Sharing Information
categories.definition: User expresses an intent to share the current information, link, or service with others.

categories.name: Gratitude and Acknowledgment
categories.definition: User expresses thanks, appreciation, or positive feedback for the provided information or service.

categories.name: Personal Advice Seeking
categories.definition: User asks for advice or guidance tailored to their specific personal situation or concerns related to COVID-19.

categories.name: Greetings/Chat
categories.definition: User initiates a conversation, offers a compliment, or uses conversational fillers without seeking specific COVID-19 related information.
